final_decision.rationale: Three legal steps, one per category. GLOBAL: 5-pair stats show HSV V invariant while S explodes (85->228 etc.) and low-channel clipping jumps to 25% - saturate_strengthen_HSV is the only function reproducing V-invariance + S gain (YCrCb variant raises V, brightness shifts V); sev2 matches target S=226.9 vs 227.8, clip=0.266 vs 0.250, mean=78.1 vs 77.6 and holds on 4/5 supports. BLUR: gm_ratio=0.329, FFT anisotropy=1.29 (not motion), gaussian/lens MTF indistinguishable -> gaussian default; PSNR peak at sev3 (23.72 vs 23.25/23.57 for sev2/4), spectral_slope diff 0.0797<0.08 and Wiener kernel corr 0.998. NOISE: sigma prior 1.48 was misleading (luma wavelet); peeled residual channel sigma ratio 2.0 and residual rgb_ratio 1.54 indicate YCrCb; smooth-sky hf matches YCrCb:3 across R/G/B [2.08,4.52,2.96] vs [2.17,4.55,3.06], while RGB/speckle/noise-free variants miss G. All steps UNCERTAIN because noise seed mismatch makes PSNR unusable (best deterministic-only PSNR 23.72<40) and structured-residual FWHM=6px is intrinsic to the noise-before-blur order.
